Scene.add.description: Register root entities with the scene and request a frame.

parameters.entities: Root entities to render and update. Add a hierarchy root once; its children are traversed through that root.

notes: This implementation pushes entries without deduplicating them. Repeatedly adding the same root can create duplicate entries.

Scene.remove.description: Remove the supplied entities and recursively destroy their descendants.

parameters.entities: Entities to remove, including their collected descendants.

notes: Removal invokes destroy; it is a lifecycle operation. Use Entity.remove to detach a child without performing this scene-level destruction.

Scene.wait.description: Insert a timed pause into choreography while the scene continues updating.

parameters.ms: Scene-timeline milliseconds. Defaults to 1000; timeScale changes its wall-clock duration.

notes: This schedules Waiting through Scene.play. Updaters and other active animations continue during the wait.
Scene.wait.returnsDescription: Resolves with the Waiting animation’s overshoot.

Scene.seekTo.description: Advance or rebuild the scene to a requested timeline time.
notes: Seeking backward resets and reruns the scene; seeking forward can use stored checkpoints. Keep run repeatable and clean up external side effects.
Fast-forward stepping and snapshot restoration do not guarantee that arbitrary DOM, random inputs or external services can be replayed deterministically.
Scene.seekTo.returnsDescription: Resolves after seeking and restoration of the prior pause state.

Scene.reset.description: Clear current content, animations and updaters, then reset the scene clock and camera.
notes: Pending animations are rejected with Scene Reset. reset does not run your choreography again; use restart for that.
Keep references rebuilt by run out of later callbacks after reset, or replace them in onAfterReset.
Scene.reset.returnsDescription: Resolves after queued GPU disposal and reset work.

Scene.restart.description: Reset the scene and invoke run again.
notes: Its promise covers reset and launching run, rather than waiting for the complete choreography.
Scene.restart.returnsDescription: Resolves after the new run has been launched.

Scene.use.description: Install a plugin and register its render features when available.

parameters.plugin: Plugin instance with a unique name and optional install, dispose and registerPasses hooks.

notes: A plugin with the same name is disposed and replaced. Install plugins after the composer exists when they need renderer access.

Scene.removePlugin.description: Dispose an installed plugin and remove its render features.

parameters.name: The name used by the installed plugin.

notes: An unknown name leaves the scene unchanged.

Scene.unregister.description: Remove a scene updater by its original callback or handle.

parameters.callbackOrHandle: The callback passed to always, or the returned AlwaysHandle.

Scene.unregister.returnsDescription: Whether the updater registry found and removed the registration.

Scene.setEvent.description: Register a canvas pointer event with a resolved world position.

parameters.type: Supported pointer event or legacy mouse alias; aliases are normalized to pointer events.
parameters.listener: Receives the world Vec3 first and the raw browser event second.
parameters.options: Coordinate-resolution settings. The default uses the Z = 0 plane without context-aware picking.

notes: Unlike Entity.setEvent, this is a scene-wide listener and its callback does not begin with the raw PointerEvent.

Scene.animateTimeScale.description: Ease the scene’s playback rate using wall-clock time.

parameters.targetScale: Desired playback multiplier. One is normal speed; small positive values produce slow motion.
parameters.durationRealMs: Transition duration in real milliseconds, independent of the slowed scene clock.

Scene.animateTimeScale.returnsDescription: Resolves when the time-scale transition finishes.

Entity.animate.description: Create a fresh Animator for a target-state transition.
notes: Each access constructs a new builder. Save the builder if you need to pause or stop that specific animation later.
Entity mutation methods apply immediately; similarly named Animator methods edit a target state until Scene.play schedules it.

Entity.animateWith.description: Create an Animator with timing options.

parameters.options: Initial AnimOptions; duration, delay and intervals use milliseconds.

Entity.animateWith.returnsDescription: A fresh Animator for this entity.

Entity.remove.description: Detach children from this parent without destroying them.
notes: Their parent becomes null; local transforms are retained, so visible world placement can change. Reattach or add them to a scene deliberately.

Entity.destroy.description: Invoke component cleanup and recursively destroy children.
notes: This implementation clears its updater registry but does not detach the entity or clear its child/component arrays. Scene.remove manages scene membership; dispose performs fuller graph cleanup.

Entity.dispose.description: Detach from the parent, dispose descendants and clear components and callbacks.
notes: The disposed object is marked invisible and must not be reused. Root membership in Scene.entities is managed separately by Scene.remove.

Entity.clone.description: Clone state and hierarchy while sharing heavy geometry resources.

parameters.recursive: Include cloned descendants when true. Defaults to true.
parameters.entityMap: Mapping used during a recursive clone to associate original and copied entities.

notes: This is not a deep copy of every GPU resource. Editing shared geometry can affect related clones; use independent geometry when it must diverge.
Entity.clone.returnsDescription: A new instance of the same concrete entity class.

Entity.getBoundingBox.description: Compute world-aligned bounds for the entity and optionally its descendants.

parameters.includeChildren: Include descendant bounds when true. Invisible nodes are skipped.

notes: Use getLocalAABB for local geometry bounds. An AABB expands under rotation and is not an oriented boundary contour.

Entity.setEvent.description: Attach an entity-specific pointer or drag handler.

parameters.type: Event name selecting the handler slot on InteractionComponent.
parameters.listener: Callback for that event. Pointer callbacks receive event and hit; drag callbacks receive the new position according to InteractionEventMap.

notes: Calling again for the same type replaces that handler. Drag event registrations also enable dragging. InteractionManager must be available to dispatch picking events.

Entity.setDraggable.description: Enable picking and configure dragging on an interaction component.

parameters.draggable: Whether the object can be dragged.
parameters.planeNormal: Optional drag-plane normal. Omit to retain the component’s current constraint.

notes: This creates InteractionComponent when needed; it does not install a scene InteractionManager.

Camera.cullingMask.description: Bitmask of layers visible to this camera.
notes: The current field initializer is 1, so layer zero is selected. seeAllLayers sets all 32 bits; the source comment claiming an all-layer default is stale.

Camera.constructor.description: Create a camera with an explicit perspective field of view.

parameters.fov_rad: Vertical field of view in radians. Pass an explicit value such as Math.PI / 3; the literal source default is 45.

Camera.lookAt.description: Face an entity or world point and retain it as the camera’s tracking target.

parameters.target: Entity or world coordinate to face; null clears automatic target tracking.

notes: Passing an entity tracks its world transform origin, which can differ from its visible bounds center.

Camera.toOrtho.description: Switch projection while matching size at a chosen subject distance.

parameters.targetDistance: World-space distance to the subject plane. Defaults to camera position length relative to the origin.

notes: A correct radian fov is required because conversion uses tan(fov / 2).

Camera.toPerspective.description: Switch to perspective and position the camera to match orthographic framing.

parameters.targetPos: World-space subject point. Defaults to the origin.

notes: The size match applies at that subject plane; objects at different depths change apparent size.

Camera.frame.description: Fit bounds into the viewport and update camera placement.

parameters.target: Entity, entities, AABB or points to include in the framing calculation.
parameters.options: Padding, aspect, direction and focus settings. Supply the actual canvas aspect for reliable framing.

notes: For orthographic projection this updates scale and position. For perspective it updates position and, unless disabled, focus distance.
Camera.frame.returnsDescription: The same camera; an invalid framing target leaves it unchanged.

Camera.getProjectionMatrix.description: Compute projection from the current camera and canvas aspect.

parameters.aspect: Canvas width divided by height; must be positive.

notes: The implementation reuses scratch matrix storage. Copy the result before retaining it across later calls.
Camera.getProjectionMatrix.returnsDescription: The current projection matrix in reused storage.

Camera.getViewMatrix.description: Compute the inverse camera-world transform, with current look-at tracking.
notes: Copy the result if it must survive later matrix computations using scratch storage.

parameters.entity: Entity whose current state supplies the animation start.
parameters.options: Initial animation timing and easing settings.

Animator.getAnim.description: Return the underlying StateAnimation and remember it for lifecycle controls.
Animator.getAnim.returnsDescription: The animation currently built by this Animator; it is not a fresh copy.

Animator.stop.description: Remove the remembered animation and freeze the current interpolated state.
notes: stop resolves the awaiting animation promise with zero and resets this builder for a new chain.

Animator.restart.description: Restart the remembered animation from the entity’s current state.
notes: This snapshots the current entity as a new start; it does not restore the original start of the first playback.
Default storage value is one. Zero makes the paint transparent without removing the entity, its events or its updaters.

Paint.strokeWidth.description: Vector outline width in scene units.
notes: Default storage value is zero. The getter reports negative values as zero; setter input is otherwise stored directly.

parameters.color: Optional outline color; omission retains the existing stroke color.
Fill color accepted by Color.from, such as a Color or supported color string.

notes: Assigning fill sets a local override and marks paint dirty for synchronization.

parameters.start: Lower clipping coordinates for the paint’s normalized clip region.
parameters.end: Upper clipping coordinates. Default storage spans [0, 0] to [1, 1].

Material.description: Describe mesh appearance and track local material overrides.
notes: Vector paint and mesh material are distinct. Entity.setOpacity changes paint; mesh opacity is controlled by material.opacity.
Defaults include white color, opacity 1, roughness 1, metallic 0, transmission 0, IOR 1.5 and specular 0.5. Raw data writes bypass setter change tracking.

Material.roughness.description: Surface roughness, normally between zero and one.
notes: Default is one. Lower values sharpen specular reflections; they do not increase mesh resolution.

Material.metallic.description: Metalness contribution, normally between zero and one.
notes: Default is zero. Color and roughness also affect the visible result.

Material.transmission.description: Transmission contribution for supported material rendering paths.
notes: Default is zero. Transmission and alpha opacity are different controls; turning on one does not configure every other glass parameter.

Material.ior.description: Index of refraction for supported refractive shading.
notes: Default is 1.5. It influences refraction when the selected pipeline supports it; it does not switch rendering pipelines.
